market_scope: publisher monitored listed services and measured facilitators, not whole x402 ecosystem

derived.interpretation: Conditional lower bound on one buyer-address/service pair within publisher-monitored rolling flow, NOT a bound on verified organic buyers or address-independent market.

caveats: Publisher's top-service and largest-buyer shares are assumed to have compatible denominators; no independent audit.
Both percentages displayed to 0.1 percentage point; bounds assume nearest-0.1 rounding with at most 0.05 pp error each.
One address is not a person or legal business; self-related and imported flow may exist.
Outside-pair volume may still include the same economic actor or wash transactions; it is not an estimate of organic demand.
Rolling 30-day windows overlap, so this snapshot cannot establish sales growth or AgentMine capture.
Source's 19.7% coverage describes measured facilitator flow, not all x402 transactions.
Selected source fields transcribed from publisher JSON response; not a preserved complete raw API response.
